editorialIntent: Prevent misleading Chile-festival claims in VIP event catalog: actual products feature Rio Carnival Champions Parade, Rio Sambadrome carnival, New Year Copacabana Rio and New Year Buenos Aires; Chile occurs as part of the journey, not host of those events. Distinguish group/private travel and Chilean Tapati as unrelated to these four offers.

externalSources.supports: Official Rio tourist department: 2026 Champions Parade on February 21 after competition shows, distinction of schedules; no 2027 date inferred.
Official tourism recap: Rio Copacabana New Year celebration and maritime fireworks, date/year-specific rather than promise for future.
Official Chile tourism: Tapati on Rapa Nui in February, activities and traditions, not included in selected Ada Tours programs.
Rapa Nui culture and February Tapati festival, distinct from Rio carnival.

constraints: Four verified current VIP/filter tour IDs only; events located in Rio de Janeiro (Carnival and Copacabana) or Buenos Aires (New Year), Chile leg is subsequent/preceding. Group versus private differences, no unsupported ticket/hotel inclusions; 2-col mobile table, dynamic count, internal links only in public Markdown.
